name: Bear Trapper Fresh Broiled Idaho Trout & Baked Potato
brandOrRestaurant: Bear Trapper Steakhouse (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Fresh broiled Idaho rainbow trout is flaky, lean, and rich in anti-inflammatory omega-3s; paired with the soft interior of a baked Idaho potato and plain dinner roll, it is one of the safest sit-down dinners in Garden City.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Fresh Idaho Trout broiled (not breaded or fried) with no lemon wedge, paired with a plain baked potato (eat the fluffy interior, leave the skin) and skip the house salad.
watchOuts: Ask for no lemon garnish (citrus trigger)
Leave the thick baked potato skin and skip the raw dinner salad
